Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<iostream>
#include<unordered_map>
#include<vector>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> twoSum(vector<int> &nums, int target)
    {
        unordered_map<int, int> dict;
        vector<int> res(2,-1);
        for (int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++)
        {
            int query = target - nums[i];
            if (dict.find(query) == dict.end())
                dict[nums[i]] = i; // map映射: value->index
            else
            {
                res[1] = i;
                res[0] = dict[query];
                return res;
            }
        }
        return {};
    }
};
// 下面是测试
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> arr = {3, 2, 4};
    vector<int> res = sol.twoSum(arr, 7);
    for (int i : res)
        printf("%d ", i);
    return 0;
}
